Use this variable in conjunction with git pull to preserve the marketplace cache in case of a failure

Use the hook to log denied requests for further analysis and debugging

items.title: Added named subagents to @ mention typeahead suggestions

items.summary: We launched a beta version of the PHP SDK.

explanation.what_it_is: The PHP SDK is a software development kit that allows developers to interact with the Anthropic API using the PHP programming language.
explanation.why_it_matters: This beta release enables PHP developers to integrate Anthropic's capabilities into their applications, potentially expanding the reach of their projects.
how_to_use: Install the PHP SDK using Composer
Use the SDK to send requests to the Anthropic API from PHP scripts
